notes.subject: אשם
notes.rationale: Gloss-ol i sugerim: 'asua' (rong), 'ofa bilong asua' (ofa bilong rong), o 'ol i tok bikhet long ofa' — tpi makim ofa bilong asua.

notes.subject: רצון
notes.rationale: רצון em i 'laik tru / pasin bilong laikim', i no jis 'fava'.

notes.subject: יליץ
notes.rationale: לוץ i save min 'open maut na kastomim', tpi makim pasin bilong kastom olsem wanpela piksa.

translation: Ol man nogut i bihainim ⟨את⟩ ofa bilong asua wantaim pasin bilong kastom; tasol namel long ol man stretpela i stap laik tru.

tokens.gloss: i bihainim wantaim pasin bilong kastom
